thread:
maria gonzalez: Quick heads up — EU Marketplace listing requires SOC2 Type II + witnessed pen-test for our HSM partner. Timeline is compressed (~3 weeks). Need artifact owners, FR/DE translations, and a confirmed witness slot. I'll list asks below.

samir patel: Is this the full SOC2 Type II report or just an attestation summary? :thinking:

olivia taylor: Full Type II. Marketplace wants the summary-of-controls PDF (public-facing) and the full report in the secure dataroom. Also need pen-test report + signed witness log.

cheng li: Proposed checklist:
```
- Owner: security (olivia) -> SOC2 summary + redaction notes
- Owner: integrations (samir) -> presigned S3 path for artifacts (48h TTL)
- Owner: partnerships (maria) -> partner comms + embargo management
- Owner: infra (cheng) -> HSM attestation + connectivity proof
- Translator: vendor (TBD) -> FR/DE translations of summary
- Pen-test: external firm -> live witness slot + signed witness statement
```

maria gonzalez: I can own partner comms and translator vendor coordination. Need someone to own S3 presigns + access TTLs.

samir patel: I can do the presigns. ETA 48h after final artifacts land. Confirm TTL? proposing 48h (short-lived).

olivia taylor: 48h TTL works. Also: redaction guidance required — remove employee emails, internal IPs, service tokens. Keep high-level control descriptions.

sec-bot: Reminder: Sensitive artifacts must go to secure-dataroom first. Use presigned links only for reviewer access and log every presign. :lock:

cheng li: Pen-test witness window: partner requested a 2-hr live witness during week of Apr 12-16. Who can attend? We should lock availability by EOD Fri.

maria gonzalez: I can attend Apr 13 morning. @samir can you confirm infra coverage for the witness session?

samir patel: Blocking Apr 13 09:00-11:00 UTC tentatively. Will need the pen firm to confirm exact 30-min slots inside that window. I'll create presign path: s3://redwood-eu-marketplace/partners/<partner>/evidence/ and set TTL to 48h.

olivia taylor: I'll draft the SOC2 summary + redaction notes and a one-pager for the marketplace listing. Draft by Wed EOD.

maria gonzalez: Action items TL;DR:
- Olivia: SOC2 summary + redaction notes (due Wed)
- Samir: presigned bucket + infra witness access (due Tue)
- Cheng: coordinate HSM attestation + witness ops (due Tue)
- Maria: partner comms & translator vendor (due Fri)
- Pen firm: confirm witness slot (ask them today)

cheng li: Ping me when presign is live and I'll validate access flow and partner IAM roles.

maria gonzalez: If everyone OK, I'll move this into the marketplace pipeline and set an internal go/no-go on Apr 9. :white_check_mark:

olivia taylor: OK from compliance side. :+1:

samir patel: OK from infra. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Checklist reminder: upload final artifacts to secure-dataroom, add audit-log entry for each presign, and tag artifacts with region=eu and sensitivity=restricted.

maria gonzalez: Thanks all — will follow up with calendar invites, translator options, and a short runbook for the witness session.
